name: Squatter
text: Once per round: place a minion on a space a rival already took.

name: Freelancer
text: You may pay any member’s colored part in any colors.

name: Tiebreaker
text: Ties you’re in go to you alone.

name: Straggler
text: Once per round, after the last minion is placed: you may move your last minion to an open space and take it.
